- The ENTIRE page background is warm beige (#F5F3EF). NOT white. NOT grey. Warm beige EVERYWHERE behind cards.

- Text must be readable French content only. Never show font names, pixel sizes, CSS code, or hex values as visible text.
- Do not add any annotations, labels, or specifications that a user would not see in a real app.
